description: R55-C07: fourteen operations decoded their request with Serde and never checked that the top level is a JSON object, so arrays were read field by field (ok:true for some) and other roots returned raw Serde text. Root rows pin the named '<name> must be a JSON object' message. Control rows carry the complete envelope, byte-identical before and after the fix (a valid request and an empty object per operation). Unknown-field rows pin the deny_unknown_fields rejection added where no client sends extra fields.
